observations.topic: answer_label's حتمی vs the settings string's آخری جواب for the same concept
observations.answer: Checked and accepted, with the divergence recorded. ui.chat.response_actions.answer_label now says 'حتمی جواب کے اعمال' (the final answer's actions), while ui.settings.appearance's turn/response description renders 'the turn's final answer' as 'باری کا آخری جواب'. Both are natural, and they are not the same English string: the settings sentence speaks about the LAST answer in time (آخری is the right word there), while the toolbar label's English is 'Answer actions' with no 'final', and the Urdu qualifier's job is to separate the turn-closing answer from the other settled responses - the distinction es (respuesta final), fr (réponse finale) and ru (финальным ответом) also made. حتمی is the locale's word for 'final' where it means definitive (ui.library.filter.scope_final 'حتمی فائلیں', ui.code_review lane state 'حتمی'), and it does not collide with anything else on the row. A later wave that touches the settings string may align it to حتمی, but that string is outside this delta and changing it would move an already-audited hash for no user-visible defect.

observations.topic: cancel_rename carries a nominal object where its rename siblings carry the verb
observations.answer: 'نام کی تبدیلی منسوخ کریں' (cancel the renaming) names the thing cancelled, while the rename actions on the same row say 'گفتگو کا نام بدلیں' / 'نام بدلیں'. That is the locale's established cancel shape - a nominal object plus منسوخ کریں ('درآمد منسوخ کریں', 'پیغام منسوخ کریں', 'ٹیگ ...'), and the round-1 N1 asked for exactly this nominalisation over the bare infinitive 'بدلنا'. No action: the pair reads as action and its cancel, not as two unrelated phrases.

None of the 38 wave-A context entries carries maxCells or maxChars. The 13 entries in these four namespaces that do carry one belong to pre-existing keys this wave never touched (ui.chat.header.conversation_name 24, archived 16, actions 28, copy_id 24, move_device 32, transcript_display 28, delete 28, close_run_details 20, open_run_details 20, new_chat 16, new_chat_with 32, ui.chat.session_status.choose_model 18, last_reading 16), so no audited value can overrun a declared budget. The two amended values measure 24 cells (cancel_rename) and 18 cells (answer_label) by the ur guide's ~1 cell per Arabic-script character rule, against English 13 and 14. Both are an accessible name / tooltip, not a fixed-width caption: cancel_rename is the header rename control's aria-label AND its native title tooltip (chat-header.tsx), answer_label is screen-reader-only (answerActionsLabel in message-actions.ts), so neither sits in a layout that can clip it. No overflow risk claimed or observed, and no rendered-frame measurement is offered - this is a catalogue audit.

observations.topic: RTL / bidi of the two amended values
observations.answer: Both are pure Urdu: no Latin/digit island, no manual bidi control (ur-activation's hygiene test scans the real bundled catalogue and finds none, and the audit's own scan counts zero U+200E/U+200F/U+2066-U+2069/U+061C). GNU fribidi 1.0.16 at base direction RTL pictures them with the phrase head on the right ('حتمی جواب کے اعمال' -> 'ﻝﺎﻤﻋﺍ ﮯﮐ ﺏﺍﻮﺟ ﯽﻤﺘﺣ'), and reversing the visual run after NFKC restores the logical string exactly for both - the same property holds for all 20 pure-RTL wave-A values. No arrow, mirrored-wrong glyph or bidi hazard arises in either string; the wave's placeholder strings with Latin substitutions keep their round-1 behaviour and are not re-scored.
